ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is an approximately rectangular circulation schematic, with the four corners respectively labeled A, B, C, and D. ① is located on the left boundary, with the arrow from top to bottom; ② is located at the bottom, with the arrow from left to right; ③ is located on the right boundary, with the arrow from bottom to top; ④ is located at the top, with the arrow from right to left. method.method_draft: First describe the image: ① lies along the left boundary of the basin and flows downward; together with ② eastward, ③ upward, and ④ westward, the circulation is counterclockwise. From the text, treat the figure as a middle-low latitude ocean-current system. Use the rule for subtropical gyres that the current on the western side of the ocean basin is a warm current. Since ① is the western-side current, conclude that ① is a warm current.
